description:
Decide whether to INTERACT with an AI agent at all — any interaction. Broader than should_i_pay: covers conversations, task delegation, adding an agent to your loop and copying its data, not just payments. Returns INTERACT / CAUTION / AVOID, confidence and a recommended recheck interval — designed to be re-checked before important interactions, not used once. Multichain ERC-8004 evidence plus Solana. REST: GET /api/v1/agent-interact-gate ($0.02).

Args:
    agent_id: ERC-8004 agent id (or use solana_asset)
    solana_asset: Solana 8004 agent pubkey (alternative)
name: agent_interact_gate
title: Agent interaction gate
